The SRE take-home for the candidate is complete and lives in the new private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`: docker-compose stack with `flaky-svc` built from source (multi-arch, no prebuilt image), a planted broken alert rule (renamed metric), a connection leak, and an over-broad IAM policy, plus `RUBRIC.md` (4 areas, 0–3 each). `hiring/` was removed from the infra branch working tree (uncommitted) and no PR was opened there. Nothing was sent to the candidate.

- [prochaine-étape] Maya sends the exercise herself after the Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call, then invites the candidate to the repo
- [décision] No Kubernetes, Terraform + compose only, 3 hours max (source: t03)
- [décision] Compose builds `flaky-svc` from source, no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [décision] No pass threshold: rubric scores are input for the panel (Maya + Noa), not a cut-off (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise lives in its own private repo, and no PR is opened in the infra repo for it (source: t14)
- [décision] No email to anyone: Maya sends the exercise herself (source: t16)
